_comment: Registered in every session where this plugin is installed, which is why guard.mjs
exits immediately unless OVERNIGHT_RUN=1 is in its environment. Only the overnight
runner sets that variable, so ordinary daytime sessions are completely unaffected.
The matcher covers the tools that can leave the project or reach the outside world.
Read is deliberately absent: Read deny rules in the settings file already cover it,
and adding a hook to every file read would slow the session for no extra safety.
